assumptions: Rows are worksheet rows emitted by repo-owned VBA handlers while real Excel/MSForms dispatched injected mouse focus changes and keyboard input.
arg_before is the ReturnBoolean/ReturnInteger argument .Value read at handler entry; arg_after is that argument .Value after the (flag-gated) handler mutation.
focus_owner_after is Me.ActiveControl.Name (empty when ActiveControl Is Nothing); text_value_after is the relevant TextBox .Text at handler exit.
unknowns: Rows absent from this run remain unobserved and are not negative MSForms facts.
This capture exercises Tab focus transfer, Exit veto, BeforeUpdate veto, and a CheckBox focus baseline; it does not exhaust accelerator, mnemonic, drag-focus, or programmatic SetFocus paths.

clean_room.source: Repo-owned fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven through public Windows input APIs.

non_claims: No OxForms runtime focus/validation event behavior is implemented or claimed by this oracle.
